column1: # Parity cases: money. Tab-separated, on purpose -- a case file two parsers
# must agree on cannot depend on a JSON parser that one side has only in part.
# Columns:  expr <TAB> ccy <TAB> amount <TAB> operand <TAB> expect <TAB> name
# operand is "-" when the expression takes none.
# An expect beginning with "!" is an error, and the rest is the message verbatim.
# A name beginning with "gbasic-defect:" is a case Python passes and gBASIC is
# known to fail. gBASIC's two money constructors disagree about the message for
# one refusal -- `{USD}= "1.23456789"` names the currency and the limit,
# `money.of("USD", ...)` does not -- though reference.md says money.of has "the
# same parse path and same refusals as the modifier". The expectation here is
# the modifier's, which is the better message; the fix belongs upstream in
# gBASIC (porting-plan.md §1.2: fix there first, then port the fixed one).
